description: This file defines a PHP trait 'PluginManagerDependentValidatorTrait' that provides common functionality for CKEditor 5 validation constraints within Drupal, including methods to retrieve enabled and disabled plugins based on certain criteria.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plugin manager.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the trait using the service container.

methods.name: getOtherEnabledPlugins
methods.description: Retrieves all enabled CKEditor 5 plugins except the specified one.

methods.name: getEnableableDisabledPlugins
methods.description: Retrieves disabled CKEditor 5 plugins that can be enabled by the user.
